lines.t: Standing in the stillness, I hear your call
Whisper through the shadows, breaking the wall
Once I walk without, chained by my fear
Now I see the purpose, your word is clear
No more hiding from who I am
Your truth has taught my heart to stand
Proud in the light, not in my name
But in the fire, you set a flame
Carried by grace, lifted by love
I find my worth in things above
Pride and truth, not in man's eyes But in the hope that never dies
Voices of deception, fade to the deep Promises eternal, a monarchy
Faith like thunder, burning bright I walk with peace through endless night
No crown, no gold, no throne, I see
Your word is strength within the me
Pride in the light, not in my name
But in the fire, you set a flame
Carried by grace, lifted by love
I find my worth in things above
Pride and truth
Ooh, not in man's eyes
But in the hope that never dies
You breathe in me the breath of dawn
Every tear now shining on
My soul reborn, my spirit free
Your love, the pride alive in me
Me, me, me, me, me
Pride in the light, not in my fame
But in the power of your name
Carried by grace, lifted by love
I'm standing true from heaven above
Pride in you, my heart's reply
Glory to you, till the end of time
Ah
